items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: I was pledged (Doyta Del Doyta?) ... [INTERVIEWER] Now (Doyta Del Doyta?) is a college fraternity? [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: I used to play a lot out at the

University of Chicago with the Maroon Five. And also went up to Lost Lake with them up in Wisconsin. A bunch of college guys. And I was naturally a highschool boy but I was pledged (Doyta Del Doyta?) and I had you know, visions of going to the University of Chicago. I wanted education naturally. Along with everything else. But going music and joining the Wolverines why that was it. I just loved music so much..... Delta Tau Delta
Now (Doyta Del Doyta?) is a college fraternity?
